verdict.rationale: BugSnag publishes its Data Access API as an OpenAPI 3.0.3 document on SwaggerHub, and its developer portal has an API reference generated from that spec, with Pagination, Rate Limiting, Authentication and Versioning pages. None of the evidence says the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples such as try-it-out request execution. The 404s on docs.bugsnag.com OpenAPI paths only show the spec is hosted elsewhere, not that it is missing. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of interactive try-it/runnable request examples, code samples per endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
